title: Day 18 of FloorFifty (Sol 5.6 + Opus 5.5) - AKA 'The Actually Finishing A Project This Time' Game | Seeking Honest Feedback
author: CrispyOwl717
selftext:
For whatever reason, at some point, I became physically incapable of finishing a project that I started. As you may be aware, the pattern will repeat until you break the cycle. So, I challenged myself to finish a very simple project from a few years back (pre-AI) and make it good.

  
I have a theory that people don't /really/ have an issue with AI games - they have an issue with intentionality. *Why* *did the author make the curtains blue?* The people don't like "AI" being the answer to that, so my guiding design principal here was (mostly) everything is a intentional decision. 

  
I'd love to get your feedback. 

*  Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop Supported. Landscape and Portrait with Gamepad Support.
* Available in 6 Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese
* Like 11 songs or so, and 6 characters with unlockable.
* 3 Modes + Multiplayer 

I don't plan on adding any additional features
